correctness.rationale: The congruence identity proves cone structure; a complete solution of restricted gradients gives exactly 15 pair partitions; Hessian has rank 3 transverse to each singular line; isolated A1 nodes imply normal integral K3 base after resolution. Complete 40-point and 820-point base censuses give B(F3)=25, B(F9)=145. Fifteen split exceptional lines imply Y(F3)=70 and Y(F9)=280. Trace formula and the Weil absolute-value bound force 21 eigenvalues +3 and one -3, hence the universal formulas. All steps and code were rechecked.
